sources.authority: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology / Building Digital UK
sources.role: The collection is an index of awarded procurement contracts. It does not establish current orderability, completed network build or measured speed for a selected parcel.
Framework and call-off values are procurement scope. Premises remain subject to planning, market research and engineering change and cannot be treated as current selected-parcel serviceability.
